features: Pattukal Taste AI in the AI hub (on by default): daily mixes, mood-based picks and discover songs from your favourites and history
Skip This Forever: hold a song or use the song menu so it is never recommended or played again
Magic Cube now sits at the top of Home and shows new songs on every refresh
Hold a language song to add it to Play Next or the queue
New Performance settings: low-end device mode, battery saver and reduce animations
Ambience is back and on by default, with an on/off switch and Stop all in the player
Karaoke removes the singer's voice while keeping the instruments
Slider styles in Settings now match the player; Wavy is the default
bug_fixes: Removed the circle that appeared when pressing player buttons
Softer glass and smoother scrolling in the Play Next list
Top songs moved lower on Home
